info.title: BoomScrolling account API
info.description: Internal Sites-authenticated API. Supplied drafts do not generate, approve or publish. Sites owns authentication; raw identity headers are not a public credential.

x-sites-authentication.description: Use the existing Sites sign-in session. No standalone cookie name, bearer-token flow or public identity-header credential is defined by this API.

get.description: Read current workspace access and provider allowance without a provider call. Sign-in, product access, X permission and funding are separate. No purchase links or private owner data.

post.description: Save 1 to 50 supplied original, quote or reply drafts to your private Yours feed. Stable candidate IDs are immutable idempotency keys. Changed payloads conflict; existing phone edits are retained. Media must first be uploaded to your account. Never generates, approves or posts. Same-origin JSON required for browser writes.

post.description: Upload a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image of at most 5 MiB using canonical standard base64. Returns an account-scoped content-addressed key for submit_candidates. Repeated identical uploads reuse the key. Does not create a draft or approve or publish anything. Same-origin JSON required for browser writes.
